title: Student cards
archived: Archived students cannot receive a new card.
reissueBody: The current card stops working as soon as the new card is issued.
oneTime: This card cannot be shown again. Print it now. Issue again to reprint.
revokeBody: The card will stop working. Choose why it is being revoked.
changed: The card changed. Status refreshed; review before trying again.
alreadyRevoked: This card is already revoked. Status refreshed.
concurrentIssue: Someone else issued cards at the same time; issue again.
studentNotInGroup: A selected student is no longer in this group. The roster has been refreshed.
selectionHelp: Select current students to issue one card each. Maximum 60 per sheet request.
bulkConfirm: I understand that existing cards for the selected students will stop working.
